title: 第19章 紫金剑胚为超品第20章 无名剑法名无极
content_zh:
此时，另一处秘境内飞出一名苍老的身影，手持一袋旱烟抽着，身形枯槁。
看见来人，厉秋雨连忙过去尊敬称呼道：“太上长老。”
来人微微点了点头，正是无极门太上长老，一直以来，他都是闭关不出，除非察觉到外面有着吸引他的异样。
“不知哪位道友在此突破？还请现身一见？”
太上长老的声音洪亮非凡，虽然不大，但是方圆几里内都能听的清楚。
眼看并无任何回复，太上长老呼出一口旱烟，看向厉秋雨，询问道：
“刚刚你可看到那异象来源处？”
“只看到丹脉上方，那异象氤氲之气最为浓重。”
厉秋雨如实回答说道。
“丹脉？难不成是祝天虹那小子造成的异象？炼成了稀世宝丹或者是境界突破了？”
太上长老诧异自语说着，这时候异象也快要散了，他扫看了丹脉所在之处一眼，也没看出具体的端倪。
便对厉秋雨说道：“下午时分的时候，你去将祝天虹唤来见我。”
“是！太上长老。”
厉秋雨尊敬点头。
太上长老离开后，厉秋雨看着散去的乌云，又露出了烈日，俏眉不由得微皱。心想，若是那祝天虹面对太上长老之时说起他徒儿之事，如何是好？如今看来，太上长老多半是会站在他那边。
不再多想，厉秋雨也回到自己的秘境内。
......
炼丹房内。
林玄身上的动静已经渐渐消失，他感觉了一番自己的实力，已经突破了。
元武境界！

实力暴涨了至少十倍以上！
这不是简单的元武境界，而是修为达到灵武极致且修成了一劫剑体后突破的元武境界！
林玄能感觉到就算是四阶妖兽，自己都能一剑干死。
“小子，你看看你的丹田！！！”
剑老诧异吃惊的声音传来。
林玄闻言，随即探查自己的丹田处，只见那里居然悬浮着一把紫金色的小剑，可以感觉到里面蕴含着极致的力量！
“这是......”
林玄非常不解，自己的剑形丹田内为何出现了一个这样的奇物，仿佛还跟自己丝丝相连。
“这便是一劫剑体衍生出来的剑胚，只要剑体成型都会产生的，不过，小子我老人家让你看的可不是这个，注意看它的颜色！”
剑老顿了顿，又继续说道：
“一劫剑体分三等，凝练出白色小剑为普通剑体，青色为精品，紫色则是极品！”
林玄露出略微不解诧异之色，道：“我这个好像是紫金色......”
content_en:
At this time, an old figure flew out of another secret place, holding a bag of dry cigarettes and smoking, with a haggard figure.
Seeing the person coming, Li Qiuyu hurriedly went over and respectfully addressed him, "Supreme Elder."
The visitor nodded slightly. He was the Supreme Elder of the Wuji Sect. He had always been in seclusion unless he noticed something strange outside that attracted him.
"I wonder which fellow Taoist has made a breakthrough here? Can you please show up to see him?"
The Supreme Elder's voice was extremely loud. Although it was not loud, it could be heard clearly within a few miles.
Seeing that there was no reply, the Supreme Elder breathed out a puff of dry smoke, looked at Li Qiuyu, and asked:
"Did you see the source of the vision just now?"
"Only the top of the alchemy veins can be seen, where the aura of the strange phenomenon is the strongest."
Li Qiuyu answered truthfully.
"Elixir? Could it be that boy Zhu Tianhong caused the strange phenomenon? Has he refined a rare treasure pill or achieved a realm breakthrough?"
The Supreme Elder said to himself in surprise. At this time, the vision was about to dissipate. He glanced at the location of the alchemy veins, but could not see any specific clues.
Then he said to Li Qiuyu: "In the afternoon, go and summon Zhu Tianhong to see me."
"Yes! Supreme Elder."
Li Qiuyu nodded respectfully.
After the Supreme Elder left, Li Qiuyu looked at the dark clouds that dispersed, revealing the scorching sun again, and her pretty brows couldn't help but frown slightly. I thought to myself, what would happen if Zhu Tianhong talked about his disciple when facing the Supreme Elder? Now it seems that most of the elders will be on his side.
Without thinking any more, Li Qiuyu returned to his secret realm.
...
In the alchemy room.
The movement on Lin Xuan's body gradually disappeared, and he felt that his strength had broken through.
Yuanwu realm!
The strength has increased by at least ten times!
This is not a simple realm of Yuanwu, but a realm of Yuanwu that has been broken through after reaching the ultimate level of spiritual martial arts and cultivating a calamity sword body!
Lin Xuan could feel that even a fourth-level monster could be killed by him with one sword.
"Boy, look at your Dantian!!!"
Jian Lao's surprised voice came.
After Lin Xuan heard this, he immediately explored his Dantian and saw a small purple-gold sword floating there. He could feel that it contained the ultimate power!
"This is..."
Lin Xuan was very puzzled as to why such a strange object appeared in his sword-shaped dantian, as if it was still connected to him.
"This is the sword embryo derived from the Yijia sword body. It will be produced as long as the sword body is formed. However, this is not what I want you to see, boy. Pay attention to its color!"
Jian Lao paused and continued:
"The sword body of Yijia is divided into three grades. The condensed white sword is the ordinary sword body, the cyan sword is the fine sword body, and the purple sword is the best sword body!"
Lin Xuan showed a slightly puzzled expression and said: "This one seems to be purple-gold..."
